meta.name: migrate-memory
meta.description: Migrate legacy NanoClaw and Claude-native memory into the shared memory tree and provider-neutral standing instructions. Run after an update reports the shared-memory breaking change, or when a group still has .seed.md, legacy CLAUDE.md/CLAUDE.local.md, Claude auto-memory, or an unindexed imported-agent-memory.md. Triggers on "migrate memory", "legacy memory", "the agent forgot everything after the switch".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将旧版记忆迁移到共享记忆树和持久指令
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果升级后智能体记忆失效或仍有旧版记忆文件
copy.tagline_en: Migrate legacy memory to shared memory tree and standing instructions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your agent forgot everything after a shared-memory breaking change

howto.what: 装上后，当发现旧版记忆文件时，Claude会先将相关任务暂停并征得批准，再把文件移到统一记忆目录、整理分类，最后输出迁移报告；符号链接只隔离不跟随。
howto.when: 当你说出“migrate memory”“legacy memory”等触发词，或更新报告提示共享记忆不兼容、组内仍存在旧版记忆文件时触发。

say.text: 请把旧版记忆迁移到共享记忆树。
更新后agent忘了所有事，帮我迁移记忆。
say.note: 对应触发词之一，立即处理。
技能会整理这些旧文件。

howto.what_en: Once installed, when legacy memory files exist, Claude pauses related tasks, obtains approval, moves files into the unified memory directory, organizes them, and produces a migration report; symlinks are quarantined without following.
howto.when_en: Triggered by phrases like “migrate memory” or “legacy memory”, or when an update reports a shared-memory breaking change or a group still has legacy memory files.

say_en.text: Please migrate the legacy memory into the shared memory tree.
The agent forgot everything after the update; migrate memory.
say_en.note: Matches a trigger phrase; the skill will handle it.

say_en.text: Migrate CLAUDE.md and .seed.md to the new format.
say_en.note: These legacy files will be organized.
